BluePearl Pet Hospital – greater Philadelphia.
We are located just south of the Queen Village neighborhood, and we serve pets and their families throughout the greater Philadelphia, South Jersey, Delaware and surrounding communities.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.
Learn more about your emergency visit.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.
Learn more about veterinary specialists.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Philadelphia.
Our Philadelphia hospital opened as Veterinary Specialty & Emergency Center in 2013 and expanded in 2017, allowing us to add a 64-slice CT scanner, minimally invasive surgery and other improvements. We are now proud to be part of the BluePearl network of veterinary specialty and emergency hospitals.
We regularly invite primary care veterinarians to the hospital for educational sessions.
Our Philadelphia hospital is convenient for those who live in or near the city, and we offer patient transportation among our three local hospitals.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at

Testimonials.
“We were visiting town and had to bring our puppy Dozer in after he experienced severe seizure-like symptoms. On a busy weekend, we were able to be prioritized and he was quickly treated and we were advised on care instructions. We were very impressed and grateful for the overwhelming kindness and helpfulness from the entire staff! Thank you for the 24/7 care you offer to our four-legged best friends.”
–Shannon R.
“My pet Mina was admitted to the hospital very sick and weak. She was discharged with antibiotics after 2 days of thoughtful treatment. It has been about a month since Mina was discharged from the hospital. She continues to improve, is putting on weight, is more alert and energetic. I cannot say enough to thank the doctors and the staff at BluePearl Philadelphia for their competence, care and compassion.”
–Patricia C.
